name: What information should I prepare for an exterior consultation?

mainEntity.name: What information should I prepare for an exterior consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your exterior consultation, it's helpful to gather any previous repair records, know your home's age, and note specific concerns or areas you'd like us to examine. This preparation allows our consultants to address your priorities efficiently and tailor recommendations. Having a clear idea of your budget or desired aesthetic can also help guide the discussion towards suitable solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare previous repair records, your home's age, and specific concerns. This helps the consultant understand your needs and provide relevant recommendations.
